value.summary: Added the API version header to respond() in lib/respond.mjs: it now returns { status: 200, body, headers: { "X-API-Version": "1" } }, with status and body unchanged. Updated tests/respond.test.mjs: the deepEqual expectation includes the new headers field (required because it asserts the exact shape), and explicit assertions pin status === 200 and body passthrough. Ran the suite with node --test; all tests pass. Satisfied: version header added, status and body preserved, tests green.
